title: Release publish executor schema
description: Publishes a chart to an OCI registry as part of `nx release publish`, at the version in its Chart.yaml. Versions already in the registry are skipped.

chartFolder.description: Folder of the chart, relative to the workspace root.

outputFolder.description: Folder for the packaged chart, relative to the workspace root or absolute.

remote.description: OCI registry to push the chart to, e.g. `oci://ghcr.io/my-org/charts`.

plainHttp.description: Use plain HTTP instead of TLS for OCI registries.

publish.description: Set to false for a chart that should not be pushed on its own, e.g. a subchart that only ships inside an umbrella chart.

repositories.description: Chart repositories to add with `helm repo add` before building dependencies; see the package executor.

dryRun.description: Package the chart without pushing it. Set by `nx release publish --dry-run`.
